landing.title_2: Demand Based Bus Allocation & Routing System
landing.subtitle: Type in your stop and where you want to go. Our smart engine digs through routes, schedules, and live commuter votes to find you the best bus in milliseconds.
landing.feature_predict_desc: Our engine ranks the fastest and most reliable buses by mixing route geometry with live commuter demand.
landing.feature_vote_desc: Vote for the routes you need. Your votes directly influence bus predictions and help BMTC plan better.
landing.feature_track_desc: Track buses in real time on a map with ETA estimates and occupancy information.
landing.feature_multilingual_desc: Available in English, ಕನ್ನಡ, हिन्दी, and తెలుగు — serving Bengaluru's linguistic diversity.
landing.step1_desc: Choose your current bus stop and destination from 8500+ stops.
landing.step2_desc: Submit your route vote and get the best bus predicted instantly.
landing.step3_desc: Track your bus in real time, see ETA, and board with confidence.
